def equation(t, A, params):

    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t**2 + p[3]*A + p[4]*A**2 + p[5]*A**3
            + p[6]*t*A + p[7]*t*A**2 + p[8]*A**4 + p[9]*np.log(t)*A**3)
